package middleware

import (
	"bytes"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// TokenRequired validates the Bearer token against the configured valid token.
func TokenRequired(validToken string) gin.HandlerFunc {
	return func(c *gin.Context) {
		authHeader := c.GetHeader("Authorization")
		if authHeader == "" {
			c.JSON(http.StatusUnauthorized, gin.H{
				"message": "Token is missing or invalid!",
				"code":    "401",
			})
			c.Abort()
			return
		}

		parts := strings.SplitN(authHeader, " ", 2)
		if len(parts) != 2 || parts[0] != "Bearer" {
			c.JSON(http.StatusUnauthorized, gin.H{
				"message": "Token is missing or invalid!",
				"code":    "401",
			})
			c.Abort()
			return
		}

		if parts[1] != validToken {
			c.JSON(http.StatusUnauthorized, gin.H{
				"message": "Token is missing or invalid!",
				"code":    "401",
			})
			c.Abort()
			return
		}

		c.Next()
	}
}

// responseBodyWriter wraps gin.ResponseWriter to capture the response body.
type responseBodyWriter struct {
	gin.ResponseWriter
	body *bytes.Buffer
}

func (w *responseBodyWriter) Write(b []byte) (int, error) {
	w.body.Write(b)
	return w.ResponseWriter.Write(b)
}

// RequestResponseLogger logs every incoming request (including raw body) and its response.
func RequestResponseLogger() gin.HandlerFunc {
	return func(c *gin.Context) {
		// --- Log Request ---
		var reqBody string
		if c.Request.Body != nil {
			bodyBytes, err := io.ReadAll(c.Request.Body)
			if err == nil {
				reqBody = string(bodyBytes)
				// Restore body so downstream handlers can read it
				c.Request.Body = io.NopCloser(bytes.NewBuffer(bodyBytes))
			}
		}

		log.Printf("[REQUEST] %s %s | Query: %s | Headers: %v | Body: %s",
			c.Request.Method,
			c.Request.URL.Path,
			c.Request.URL.RawQuery,
			c.Request.Header,
			reqBody,
		)

		// --- Capture Response ---
		rw := &responseBodyWriter{
			ResponseWriter: c.Writer,
			body:           bytes.NewBuffer(nil),
		}
		c.Writer = rw

		c.Next()

		// --- Log Response ---
		log.Printf("[RESPONSE] %s %s | Status: %d | Body: %s",
			c.Request.Method,
			c.Request.URL.Path,
			c.Writer.Status(),
			rw.body.String(),
		)
	}
}
